name: Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE), Far Detector Technical Design Report, Volume I: Introduction to DUNE

summary.plain: The introductory volume of DUNE's official engineering plan: what the experiment is for and how its parts fit together.
summary.technical: DUNE FD TDR Vol. I (arXiv:2002.02967, Feb 2020): overview of the DUNE physics programme, the LBNF beam, near and far detectors, and the collaboration's organisation.
